spans.s: छत्र (I) m. A mushroom.
छत्र (II) n. A parasol, an umbrella, शशिप्रभं छन्नमुभे च चामरे R.iii.16, M.ii.246.
छत्रा f. A mushroom, M.v.19.
छात्र (I) m. A pupil, a disciple.
छात्र (II) n. A kind of honey.
छत्र-धर, -धार m. a servant whose duty it is to bear an umbrella.
छत्र-धर, -धार m. a servant whose duty it is to bear an umbrella.
छत्र-धारण n. 1. carrying a parasol or umbrella as a type of royal authority; 2. carrying or bearing a parasol, M.ii.178.
छत्र-पति m. a king over whom a parasol is carried as a mark of dignity, a sovereign emperor.
छत्र-भंग m. 1. loss of dominion, deposition; 2. dependence; 3. a forlorn condition, widowhood.
छत्रक (I) m. A temple in honour of Śiva.
छत्रक (II) n. A mushroom.
छत्राक n. A mushroom, M.v.19.
छत्रिक m. The bearer of a parasol.
छत्रिन् (I) a. (f. णी) Having or bearing a parasol.
छत्रिन् (II) m. A barber.
छत्रिन् (I) a. (f. णी) Having or bearing a parasol.
छत्वर m. 1. A bottte; 2. a bower.
छात a. (f. ता) 1. Cut, divided; 2. thin, emaciated, feeble, (pp. of छो q.v.).
छात a. (f. ता) 1. Cut, divided; 2. thin, emaciated, feeble, (pp. of छो q.v.).
छात्र-गंड m. an indifferent student of poetry knowing only the beginnings of stanzas.
छात्र-दर्शन n. fresh butter prepared from milk one day old.
छात्र-व्यंसक m. a dull pupil.
